first_week.selection_method: retained unchanged from the unexecuted v95 prospective design recorded before any v95 raw data collection

inherited_failure_to_solve.finding: common spot-perpetual acceptance could work at an eight-hour level, but two newly formed four-hour boundaries failed immediately; target skipping explained one trade but not the family failure
inherited_failure_to_solve.design_response: remove mechanical clock boundaries entirely and make level authority an observable causal life-cycle

locked_hypothesis.detector: a completed fifteen-minute swing is confirmed only after two later completed fifteen-minute bars
locked_hypothesis.survival: the confirmed swing must remain externally unbreached for eight hours and expires forty-eight hours after confirmation
locked_hypothesis.market_memory: after the eight-hour survival period, price must revisit within 0.15 prior ATR and close at least 0.25 prior ATR away within five completed minutes without first breaching the level
locked_hypothesis.one_use_rule: the first later external breach consumes the level whether or not a trade is eventually opened
locked_hypothesis.acceptance: at least two closes remain beyond the old level in the three-minute classification window, basis-adjusted spot also crosses, spot acceptance is at least 25% of perpetual acceptance, and basis expansion contributes at most 75%
locked_hypothesis.delivery_confirmation: same-direction displacement closes beyond the old level, leaves a causal three-candle FVG, and a later completed-minute retest touches the gap while closing beyond both its midpoint and the old level
locked_hypothesis.invalidation: a retest trading 0.10 prior ATR back inside the old level invalidates acceptance
locked_hypothesis.objective: the nearest intact and causally confirmed fifteen-minute swing in the delivery direction; never skip it to manufacture a larger reward/risk ratio
locked_hypothesis.cost_gate: if that nearest natural target does not produce strictly positive cost-after reward/risk, do not trade rather than selecting a farther target
locked_hypothesis.ambiguous_state: no trade when maturity, defense, common acceptance, displacement, retest, invalidation or target state is incomplete

promotion_rule: The central variant, at least one adjacent retest horizon, and at least one adjacent maturity horizon must pass every original weekly gate under NautilusTrader. Otherwise execute the one precommitted core-variable ablation on the same immutable week before discarding.

precommitted_single_ablation.name: REMOVE_PRIOR_DEFENSE_MEMORY
precommitted_single_ablation.held_fixed: confirmed fifteen-minute swing, eight-hour survival, forty-eight-hour expiry, first-breach consumption, spot-perpetual acceptance, basis bound, displacement, FVG, retest, invalidation, nearest-only target, costs, 3% NAV risk and NautilusTrader execution
precommitted_single_ablation.interpretation: tests whether the prior rejection is genuine information about resting liquidity or merely a frequency-suppressing condition

research_basis.reference: Chung and Bellotti (2021), Evidence and Behaviour of Support and Resistance Levels in Financial Time Series, arXiv:2101.07410
research_basis.implication: repeat bounces strengthen subsequent barrier behaviour while predictive power decays with age

research_basis.reference: Osler (2001/2006), Currency Orders and Exchange-Rate Dynamics: Explaining the Success of Technical Analysis
research_basis.implication: take-profit orders can interrupt trends at known levels while stop-loss clusters can intensify movement after a genuine break

research_basis.reference: Degryse, de Jong, van Ravenswaaij and Wuyts (2005), Aggressive Orders and the Resiliency of a Limit Order Market
research_basis.implication: an aggressive shock alone is insufficient; subsequent price and liquidity response distinguishes partial reversal from persistent impact
